description: Searches the public profiles of Swiss firms on agentready.ch by trade, service, place, firm name or website, e.g. «Fahrschule Winterthur» or «loaded.ch». Returns up to limit firms, each with slug, name, category, region, short description, services, the full profile link (profile_url_absolute) and can_contact (whether the firm takes messages through agentready.ch). A query with a website returns the profile on that domain first, with exact_match: true; when no result has exact_match: true, that firm is not listed.

query.description: What the user looks for: trade, service, firm name, place or website, e.g. «Fahrschule Winterthur» or «loaded.ch».

region.description: Optional. A town, canton or region, e.g. Winterthur or Zug.

name: search_companies
title: Search Swiss companies
